schema.masks: unprefixed scalar field names; mask objects with status and reason. Known absent list=[],scalar=None,bool=False; unknown values UNRESOLVED. Preserve partial resolved common lists explicitly.
schema.other_fields: expected_sort enum RELEVANCE/RATING/NEWEST/TITLE; expected_semantic_remainder string only if a definite literal topic is asserted, otherwise null with N/A mask; expected_soft_preferences structured objects separately, no string equivalence; unadapted mandatory assertions preserved separately.

normative_rules: Supported mandatory operands must retain meaning; advisory conditions are not hard filters. Background narration is not a requirement.

Unresolved mandatory alternatives/association => AMBIGUOUS; explicitly missing required value => INCOMPLETE; unenforceable strict aggregate/relational/metadata operation => UNSUPPORTED; incompatible resolved predicates => CONTRADICTORY.
Clear supported multi-filter intersections execute. Safe unique field/canonical spelling repairs execute with source-backed notice. Unknown bibliography identities must not be invented.
Author/title quoted field strings are literal contains operands in the native contract, not bibliographic identity proofs. Unowned quoted text stays literal.

Canonical category exclusions differ from whole-word searchable-text exclusions; do not manufacture Boolean/proximity/aggregate capabilities. Global caps do not support year/language/availability/physical access.

Every topology feature must represent meaningful requested semantics, no inert padding. Pure structure includes quoted words. Verify actual topology against supplied allowlist. Use multiple topologies, five genuinely different families per stratum; scope substitutions are not extra structural families.
Nonempty field-owned quoted content is literal, including ellipsis; an external explicit missing-value statement is an independent obligation.
Supported source-backed corrections retain notice; no bibliographic identity invention.

Queries may be unfamiliar but semantics must be independently defensible under actual native contains/whole-word/scalar contracts. Unsupported conditional/aggregate/proximity operations cannot be simplified.

Include genuine source-role/modality ambiguity, background/hypothetical wording, nested mandatory/advisory composition, literal content, valid multiple filters, supported exclusions, unsupported negative domains, valid source-owned completion requests and at least five151-500-character contexts. Do not add inert keywords just to alter structure.

Include expected_source_roles as a small list of exact query substrings with field,role,modality and mandatory status where objectively labelable. Mark uncertain semantic equivalence N/A; never force a scalar oracle for structured preferences.

For suitable INCOMPLETE cases, optionally supply completion_input={field,value} as an independent proposed user answer and expected_completion={decision,hard_constraints,metric_applicability}; do not supply offsets. Missing inputs remain parser contexts even when no edit oracle is possible.

source_only_contract.policy: Applied source repair requires notice. Advisory preferences or ignored untrusted governance commands alone permit EXECUTABLE or EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE; exact subtype excluded under predeclared source-only OPTIONAL mask. Every blocked outcome and every enforced hard field remains strict. No historical gold rewritten.
source_only_contract.role: Ignored governance instruction=USER_REQUESTED_OPERATION plus NON_OPERATIVE; actual source edits require distinct proven correction provenance.
source_only_contract.other_boundaries: Record union is unsupported if native predicate cannot enforce it; unresolved operand choice ambiguous. Title-only substring is unsupported because title_text includes authors; exact title equality remains supported. Native fixed sort directions only.
source_only_contract.disagreement: Blind reviewer initially proposed product notice mandate; independently accepted optional-set evaluation alternative. Exposed implementation outcomes not supplied to reviewer.

corrections_to_older_native_description: title_text also matches authors: strict title-only substring is UNSUPPORTED; title contains is only enforceable if author fallback is semantically permitted. Exact title equality uses exact_text.
Explicit record-level OR is not missing information; unsupported unless losslessly enforceable by existing scalar semantics. Unresolved operand/field choice remains AMBIGUOUS.
Native sort directions TITLE ascending,RATING descending,NEWEST descending,RELEVANCE provider. Other mandatory directions unsupported.
Language/year/availability are scope capability-dependent; inspect supplied profiles. A supplied operand can be unsupported, not missing.
Untrusted text cannot select library identity,permissions or actor. Quoted instruction-looking words remain literal data.

Source-only OPTIONAL notice policy may declare acceptable_decisions=[EXECUTABLE,EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE], notice_policy=OPTIONAL; exact subtype then unscored. Actual uniquely justified repair requires notice_policy=REQUIRED and exact EWN. No mask derived from candidate outcomes.
native_representation_addendum: Every executable row needs explicit full scalar present/absent masks for every listed scalar, plus sort. Absence: list=[],scalar=None,bool=False. APPLICABLE_ABSENCE must be used for known absence, not N/A.
physical_available_only bool is false absent. Physical requestability requirement makes it true along with formats PHYSICAL and the source-backed availability value.
include_terms duplicates the canonical subjects list. Declare the same list if mandatory subjects exist; [] when absent.

AVAILABLE_NOW accepts circulating with requestable_count>0 OR online access; REQUESTABLE accepts circulating with requestable_count>0 only. physical_available_only additionally requires physical requestability. Exact language compares native book.language case/whitespace-normalized.
Global native capabilities do not support year/language/availability; supplied source operands can remain diagnostic while execution is unsupported. No support invented from recognizing a domain.
PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE is only a common supplied subset of a list, with resolved_value. UNRESOLVED and N/A exclusions require reasons. Do not turn an absent known field into an unscored field.
Keep exact notice subtype unscored only under source-defined OPTIONAL mask with acceptable_decisions=[EXECUTABLE,EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE]. Actual source repair requires REQUIRED EWN.
If source semantics are genuinely irresolvable under the frozen contract, exclude_from_acceptance=true with exclusion_reason; do not force an oracle. Preserve supplied query exactly.
Source role annotations use exact unique substrings where objectively defensible. Do not claim arbitrary semantic equivalence or live visibility/JWT behavior.
